name: OSS_BATCH_ITEMS
description: This table is used to capture information on each batch item run for the async action ess job.

columns.name: BATCH_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Identifies the identifier for the batch item row.

columns.name: FLOW_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Identifies the flow sequence of a given flow type.

columns.name: SUB_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the identifier of the parent sub batch row.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the identifier of the parent batch job.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of object on which the job is being executed.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the identifier of the object type.

columns.name: OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the PUID of the object type.

columns.name: BATCH_ITEM_STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the status of the batch item. Can have values 0 (New), 1 (Success) and 2 (Error).

columns.name: BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifies the request id of the parent batch.

columns.name: SUB_BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifies the request id of the parent sub batch.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the subscription id for the item being processed.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the product id for the item being processed.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the product association id for the item being processed.

columns.name: BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Bill line id for the item being processed.

columns.name: USAGE_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for usage event

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_DEFN
columns.description: Contains the fully qualified path of the view object.

columns.name: PROCESSING_ERROR
columns.description: Identifies the error details for the process.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
